# اِطْمَأْنِنْ (iṭmaʔnin) /itˤ.maʔ.nin/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
# اِطْمَأْنِنَّ (iṭmaʔninna) /itˤ.maʔ.nin.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِطْمَأَنَّ (iṭmaʔanna)
